messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up — customer OrionEdge saw ~12m of failed requests during a peering rollover at ~22:10 UTC. Hosted fallback worked but p95 doubled.

maria: Thanks. Same symptom class as other recent peering withdraws (short withdraw + PMTU/ICMP).

sasha: I'll pull flow logs and BGP events. Can you save the LB errors?

kevin: LB snippet:
```
2026-03-23T22:09:58Z orion-prod lb1 ERROR conn_reset reason=icmp_frag_needed
2026-03-23T22:10:05Z orion-prod healthcheck FAIL code=504 route=peer-us-west
```

aj: devops-bot: autopilot note: fallback to hosted occurred at 22:10:08. No token loss; latency hit logged.

lia: Hypothesis: MTU mismatch + ICMP blocked on customer's edge. Last time the follow-ups slipped when ownership rotated mid-sprint.

maria: Proposed actions:
- A1: Confirm customer firewall allows PMTU ICMP types (owner: sasha) due 2026-03-27
- A2: Add MTU/ICMP probe to onboarding and alert on ICMP-unreach spike (owner: lia) due 2026-03-30
- A3: Short-term: change fallback policy to prefer dedicated fallback pool for 2m before full hosted fallback (owner: kevin) due 2026-03-28
- A4: Assign recurring-pattern owner for peering withdraws and start monthly triage (owner: maria) due 2026-04-03

sasha: Starting A1; will request temporary access from customer to verify firewall rules. Flow logs uploaded to ticket.

kevin: Drafting A3 PR now; will tag the task.

lia: Working on A2 synthetic in staging, will validate alert thresholds.

aj: Will add remediation-owner persistence to runbook (A5) and coordinate sprint time.

devops-bot: Tasks created: https://redwood-internal/tasks/ORION-POST-2801239876 (A1,A2,A3,A4,A5).

maria: Let's reconvene Wed 09:30 PT to review progress. Update tasks when you start. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Thanks — closing this quick thread.
